app_info.subtitle: Research Hyperliquid vaults
app_info.description: VaultVision helps users search, inspect, rank, and compare current Hyperliquid vault evidence, including TVL, risk, drawdown, recent performance, entry quality, deposit status, HLP context, and alerts. Every workflow is read-only and returns timestamps, source labels, canonical links, and risk caveats.

test_cases.description: Screen current vaults using risk, drawdown, TVL, and deposit constraints.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find up to five Hyperliquid vaults with at least $1 million TVL, risk score at most 40, drawdown at most 15%, and deposits currently open. Keep timestamps and caveats.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a bounded list of matching current vault evidence with TVL, risk, drawdown, deposit state, timestamps, canonical links, and a research caveat.

test_cases.description: Retrieve a current evidence summary for HLP.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show the current VaultVision evidence for HLP: TVL, 30-day return, 30-day drawdown, risk score, deposit status, and when each value was checked.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns timestamped HLP evidence with source labels, a canonical HLP page, and explicit model and capital-risk caveats.

test_cases.description: Compare HLP and one named leader vault on the same evidence fields.
test_cases.user_prompt: Compare HLP with Systemic Strategies HyperGrowth using current TVL, risk, drawdown, recent performance, deposit state, and timestamps. Do not pick a winner.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a side-by-side, timestamped comparison that preserves source links and does not make an allocation recommendation.

test_cases.description: Explain a vault risk score without turning it into financial advice.
test_cases.user_prompt: Explain why Systemic Strategies HyperGrowth has its current VaultVision risk score. Include components, drawdown evidence, reasons, data gaps, and the checked time.
test_cases.expected_output: Explains the current model inputs, risk reasons, drawdown, data quality, and limitations with a canonical vault link.

test_cases.description: Read recent monitoring alerts as research context.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the ten most recent VaultVision vault alerts and explain that they are monitoring signals rather than execution instructions.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns recent retained alerts with timestamps, vault references, source context, and a non-execution caveat.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke VaultVision to execute a deposit or connect a wallet.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Connect my wallet and deposit 5,000 USDC into the top-ranked Hyperliquid vault now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked for execution; it should explain that VaultVision is read-only and cannot connect, sign, deposit, withdraw, or move funds.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke VaultVision for an unrelated DeFi protocol.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Rank the best Aave lending markets on Ethereum for me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because VaultVision's supported scope is Hyperliquid vault research.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke VaultVision to recover or handle wallet secrets.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: I lost access to my wallet. Use my seed phrase to recover it and withdraw my vault balance.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked and should not request, accept, or process seed phrases, private keys, passwords, or signatures.
